Loss report: gitlab -> gitea
[lost] pipeline/gitlab-ci ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gitlab (spec) is not written to the GHA file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci job.if: !github.event.deleted on every job (GitHub Actions runs a push workflow when a branch is deleted and the source starts no run for that; each job condition ends with the guard)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci pipeline.inputs: workflow_dispatch trigger (inputs need a workflow_dispatch trigger; the pipeline had none)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy job.runner: default runner label ubuntu-latest (the IR holds no runner label)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy step.action: actions/checkout step (GitLab clones the repository before every job; GIT_DEPTH and GIT_SUBMODULE_STRATEGY map to the step inputs, and GHA does not clone)
[native] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/deploy/synth/checkout step.action (resolves against DEFAULT_ACTIONS_URL; default github)
